title: Onde estive ontem
theme: Passado de "to be" (was/were) + time markers de passado
goal: Aluno sai sabendo conjugar was/were (positivo, negativo, perguntas) e usar marcadores de tempo passado (yesterday, last week, two days ago).
connects_to: M15 (O que fiz ontem) — depois de descrever estados passados, fala de AÇÕES passadas com verbos regulares.
module_chunks: I was / you were / he was / she was / it was
Was I...? / Was she...? / Were you...? / Were they...?
Yes, I was. / No, she wasn't.
yesterday / last night / last week / last month / last year
two days ago / a year ago / an hour ago

units.title: Eu estava lá
units.real_life_context: Você conta onde estava e como se sentia em momentos do passado.

grammar.explanation: "I" no passado usa "was". "I was at home" = "Estava em casa".
Plurais (they/we/you) usam "were" no passado.
She/he/it usam "was" no passado.

grammar.sentence: We _____ in São Paulo last month.
grammar.explanation: "We" plural usa "were".
"I was happy" — passado de "I am". "Was" pra I/he/she/it.

grammar.sentence: They _____ at the cinema last night.
grammar.explanation: "They were" — plural sempre "were".

grammar.sentence: Maria _____ a student two years ago.
grammar.explanation: Maria = she → "was". 3ª pessoa singular passada.
"We" plural → "were", não "was". Apenas I/he/she/it usam "was".
She/he/it → "was" (singular). "Were" é pra plurais e "you".

grammar.passage: Yesterday I was at home. My family was with me. We were happy together. It was a great day.
grammar.question: Onde o narrador estava ontem?
grammar.explanation: O texto diz "I was at home".

roleplay.scenario: Charlotte quer saber onde você estava e como estava ontem.

objectives.hidden_prompt: user states past location with 'I was at/in + place + yesterday'
user states past state with 'I was + adjective' (tired/happy/busy/sad)

objectives.label_pt: Dizer onde alguém da família estava

units.title: Não estava lá
units.real_life_context: Você corrige informações erradas sobre o passado ou diz onde não estava.

grammar.explanation: "I wasn't / was not" — passado negativo de "I". Contração de "was not".
"They weren't / were not" — plural negativo passado. Contração de "were not".
She → "wasn't / was not". 3ª pessoa singular.
We → "weren't / were not". Plural negativo.
"I wasn't / was not at home" — passado negativo. Contraído.
"They weren't / were not happy" — passado negativo plural.
"He wasn't / was not at school" — 3ª pessoa singular negativa.
"We" plural → "weren't / were not". "Wasn't / Was not" é só pra I/he/she/it.
She → "wasn't / was not". "Weren't / Were not" é pra plurais.

grammar.passage: I wasn't at the party last night. My friends were there but I was tired. They weren't happy that I missed it.
grammar.question: Onde o narrador não estava?
grammar.explanation: O texto diz "I wasn't / was not at the party last night".

units.title: Você estava lá?
units.real_life_context: Você pergunta sobre onde alguém estava e como estava.

grammar.explanation: "Were + you" — "you" usa "were" no passado. Inversão direta na pergunta.
"Was + she" — she usa "was". Inversão no passado.
"Were they?" — plural usa "were".
"Where were you?" — WH + were + sujeito.
"Was he?" — he/she/it com "was" em pergunta.
"How was your weekend?" — singular usa "was".
"Yes, I was" — short answer com to be passado.

grammar.hint: "Did" não cabe aqui — verbo "to be" no passado é was/were
grammar.explanation: Pergunta com "to be" passado usa was/were, não "did". "Did" é pra outros verbos.
They → "were", não "was". Plural sempre "were".

grammar.passage: Q: Were you at the meeting? A: Yes, I was. Q: Was Maria there too? A: No, she wasn't. She was sick.
grammar.question: Onde Maria estava?
grammar.answer: sick (or "she was sick" — at home implied)
grammar.explanation: O texto diz "She was sick" — explicando por que ela não estava na reunião.

listening_speaking.text: Yes, I was. No, I wasn't.

units.title: Ontem, semana passada
units.grammar_focus: Time markers of the past (yesterday, last X, X ago, in YEAR)
units.real_life_context: Você usa marcadores temporais pra ancorar eventos passados na linha do tempo.

grammar.explanation: "Yesterday" = passado (ontem). "Today" = hoje, "tomorrow" = amanhã.
"Last week" = semana passada. "Next" = futuro; "this" = atual.
"Two hours ago" = duas horas atrás. "Ago" sempre depois do tempo, indica passado.
"In + ano": "in 1990", "in 2020". Não confundir com "on + date" (on the 5th).
"Last night" = ontem à noite. "Last + Monday/week/month/year" também.
"Three years ago" = três anos atrás. Posição: depois do tempo.
"In + month": in January, in February.

grammar.sentence: I was here ago two hours.
grammar.answer: I was here two hours ago.
grammar.explanation: "Ago" SEMPRE depois do tempo: "two hours ago", "three days ago". Nunca antes.

grammar.sentence: We were on vacation at January.
grammar.answer: We were on vacation in January.
grammar.explanation: Meses usam "in", não "at". "In January", "in summer".

grammar.passage: I was in São Paulo last month. Two years ago I was in Rio. In 2020 I was in Lisbon.
grammar.question: Quando o narrador esteve em Lisbon?
grammar.explanation: O texto diz "In 2020 I was in Lisbon".

listening_speaking.text: We were in Italy last week.
She was here two hours ago.
He was at the party last night.

units.title: Era assim antes
units.grammar_focus: Integration was/were + descriptions of past states
units.real_life_context: Você descreve como era sua vida antes — onde, com quem, como.

grammar.explanation: "I was a child in 2010" — passado de I. Was + sujeito singular.
"We were neighbors" — passado plural.
She → "was". Passado singular.
"I was tired and sad" — passado de "I am".
"It was" — passado de "it is".
"They were best friends" — passado plural.
"Were you happy?" — pergunta com you no passado.

grammar.sentence: I were happy when I was young.
grammar.answer: I was happy when I was young.
grammar.explanation: I → "was", não "were". Mesmo em frases longas, mantém was.
They → "were", não "was". Plural sempre were.

grammar.passage: When I was a child, we were poor but happy. My parents were always busy. It was a simple life.
grammar.question: Como estavam os pais?
grammar.explanation: O texto diz "My parents were always busy".

listening_speaking.text: It was a long time ago.
